name: tailor
description: Tailor — resume tailoring engine (Phase 1). Modular monolith: web (Next.js API) + worker (Node) + mobile (Expo), sharing db/modules/shared-types.

comments.overrides: Pin a single React 18.3.1 repo-wide. @react-pdf/renderer 4.x (worker PDF rendering, ADR-012) needs React 18; its reconciler throws React error #31 on React 19 elements. The web app is API-routes-only (no React rendering), so its React version is cosmetic, and React Native 0.76 (mobile) already uses 18.3.1. Without this, Next 15.5 / @react-email/render drag in React 19 and npm dedupes it into the worker, breaking PDF rendering.
